services.name: 2025 Regal LS6 Surf
services.desc: The 2025 Regal LS6 Surf combines luxury day-boating comfort with the technology needed to create customizable waves for wakesurfing and other active days on the water. Designed for families who enjoy cruising, entertaining and watersports, its spacious bow, versatile cockpit and low swim platform provide comfortable gathering areas throughout the boat. Powered by a Volvo V8 380 HP Forward Drive with EVC2 and DuoProp drive, this 26-foot surf boat delivers responsive performance and confident handling. The Regal Surf System, ballast system and Surf 2.0 Tabs allow the operator to adjust the wake for different riders and skill levels. Premium equipment includes dual 12-inch Volvo Glass Cockpit

services.name: Tiara Yachts
services.desc: Meet Captain Peter, a Hucks Delivery Captain and your local guide to boating adventures in the 1000 Islands. The 1000 Islands Experience is a collection of authentic boating adventures, day trips, waterfront dining ideas and local favourites shared by Captain Peter and the team at Hucks Marine & Resort in Rockport, Ontario. At Hucks, boating has always been about more than the boat. It is about bringing people together, discovering new places and creating memories for a lifetime.
